attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.call_edges WHERE caller_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_function OR is_method) AND callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_function OR is_method) AND passes_as_callback AND NOT calls_directly AND caller_symbol_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND callee_symbol_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND NOT is_self_call

request:
Inside the bodies of functions and methods in the click library (src/click/), where is a module-level function or a method defined in the repository passed by reference as an argument to another call (so the receiving call is expected to invoke it) rather than being called at that point? Module-level code outside any function, and nested helper functions, do not count. Give the symbol ID of the function or method containing the call and the symbol ID of the function passed, one row per distinct pair.

Requested output columns: passing_symbol_id (string), passed_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds call edges where a function/method in src/click passes another function/method as a callback reference without calling it directly, returning distinct caller/callee symbol pairs.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.call_edges WHERE caller_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_function OR is_method) AND callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_function OR is_method) AND passes_as_callback AND NOT calls_directly AND caller_symbol_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND callee_symbol_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND NOT is_self_call
